description.value: A 44-site BC Parks front-country campground in the Okanagan & Thompson region with a well-appointed amenity set including showers, potable water, and e-bike charging; the site operates seasonally, with gates potentially open off-season but no services or fees outside the main window.

address.value: 6191 Savona Access Rd, Savona, BC V0K 2J0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website loaded but delivered only site-wide navigation content; no park-specific facility details were visible, and all subpages returned 404 errors. OSM tags supply the most concrete data: capacity=44, power_supply=yes, internet_access=no, fee=yes, and operator=Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd. Because the website content does not confirm any specific amenities, nearly all optional amenity fields are null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: Website loaded but returned only site-wide navigation content; no park-specific amenity or facility details were accessible. All probed subpages returned 404 errors. OSM-listed phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) could not be verified against website content.
OSM tags power_supply=yes and internet_access=no could not be confirmed via website content and are not treated as authoritative for amenity claims.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks campground with 44 sites listed on the official provincial parks website; confirmed open with no closure indicators.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM operator contact email parkinquiries@telus.net appears to be a regional Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd. inbox rather than a park-specific address. OSM capacity=44 is the best available site-count figure.
